nightdash: 🚨 nightly alert: SLO drift detected on master — p95 latency +35% vs baseline (03:10-03:25 UTC). Top affected routes: kernel-selector + batching path. Dashboard: https://nightdash.internal/redwood/alerts/4422

oliver: saw this, thanks. pinging @sophie @ryan for recent merges to kernel selector / batcher. any idea?

sophie: I merged PR #867 (adaptive-batch-heuristic) yesterday afternoon. it tweaks the batching hold window to favor larger batches under low concurrency (commit 7f4a2b3). could be related.

ryan: CI perf shows regression too — `perf-ci/nightly-master` failed: p95 +33%, p50 +2.8%. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4422/logs

maria: quick local profile on a canary node at 03:12 UTC. flamegraph: https://perf.internal/flame/4422.svg. Top stacks show `kernel_select::probe` and `kv_cache::lock_wait` spikes. looks like batcher is holding requests longer -> kv lock contention up.

oliver: ok that lines up. can someone run a bisect to confirm? if 7f4a2b3 is the culprit we should revert and roll canary back.

sophie: starting bisect now. command: ```git bisect start --bad master --good origin/nightly-base
# then
git bisect run ./scripts/perf-harness.sh --metric p95```

ci-bot: perf-ci: reproducible regression range found for job 4422 (suspect range includes 7f4a2b3..master). attaching artifacts.

ryan: agree revert if bisect confirms. also propose a short-term safety gate: if kv-lock wait > 10ms, batcher should fallback to immediate flush (prevent growth of p95).

sophie: bisect step completed locally: first bad commit is 7f4a2b3 (adaptive-batch). I can open a revert PR now — creating #871. reproduced perf harness: p95 +36% with 7f4a2b3 present.

maria: mitigation: lowering batch hold for canary and dedicated perf pools: set env `BATCH_HOLD_MS=8` and throttle batch size. pushing a runtime flag to canary now.

oliver: :thumbsup: @sophie please push revert and @ci-bot trigger canary rollback after merge. i'll coordinate with infra to monitor tail latency in next 2 hours.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback will be triggered automatically on merge of revert PR #871. notifying on-call infra.

ryan: postmortem action items (short): 1) add KV-lock metric to batcher heuristics, 2) add perf CI guard for p95 +10% on merges touching batching/kernel selector, 3) revert defended by automated rollback policy.

sophie: filing follow-ups in issues: #2021 (batcher safety gate), #2022 (perf-ci merge guard). will loop back once revert is merged and canary stabilizes.

oliver: thanks all — monitoring dashboard now. if anything else pops up tag this thread.
